name: Усунення захисника (1)
description:
In chess, it is important that your pieces are well protected. This makes it less attractive for the opponent to capture your pieces, since you can always capture back. 

Your opponent will naturally try to play in the same way by protecting their pieces. Nevertheless, tactical possibilities sometimes even arise when enemy pieces are well protected. If the protection of a piece is limited then you can first go after the defender and win material subsequently.

What do you have to do? 

Win material by first eliminating an important defender.

examples.text: The bishop on f5 is only protected by the black knight. This knight can be eliminated with 1.Rxe7! Note that white can capture on d7 in between if black chooses to capture on d3. This is called a desperado. We will revisit this trick later.
With a small combination White can win material. 1.Nxc5! eliminates the important defender of the knight on d4.
